contradictions.what: Rep first named Maya as final decider, then revealed Greg held the contract and signed; rep revised to Maya chose, Greg decided whether to buy.
Rep said we were there to keep the incumbent honest, yet signing followed the data session that engaged Greg.
Rep sells globally (global slide) but customer is US plus a handful in Canada; the slide got silence.

dodges.question: How big was that bucket?
